title: Your agreement
introduction: Enter your invited email address to receive a one-time code. Enter that code here to open your requested legal details or agreement.
boundary: Requesting a code creates or reuses a private signing identity, not a Studio workspace. It does not activate a partnership or subscription.
sent: We sent a one-time code to your invited email address. Keep this page open and enter the code below; you do not need to open Store or create a Studio account.
unavailable: This invitation is unavailable, expired, or not configured. Contact the sender for help.
failed: This code could not be verified. Enter the newest code sent to the invited email address, or choose Send new code.
expired: This code has expired or has already been used. Choose Send new code and enter only the newest one.
sendFailed: The verification email could not be sent. Your invitation is unchanged. Please try again.
rateLimited: Please wait a minute before requesting another code. Use the newest code already in your inbox.
missing: Open the private invitation link from your Artanrecords invitation email. This page cannot identify your agreement without that link; a sign-in code alone is not an invitation.
accessFailed: Your email is verified, but the agreement could not be opened. Try Open agreement again; you do not need another verification code.
connectionFailed: We could not reach the verification service. Check your connection and try again.
